card.name: Digits inside dose and table numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit that begins or sits inside a multi-digit number, just before the next digit or a decimal point. It appears in dosing tables, conversion charts, and dose ranges.

modes.label: Number tables
modes.description: Digits within long rows of numbers in conversion or dose charts.

modes.label: Digits in doses
modes.description: A leading or middle digit of a dose, interval, or concentration in running text.

card.writes: It favors code-like tokens and suppresses blank or broken tokens, so there is no clear link to the next digit.
card.plain: It fires on a digit in the middle of a number, such as the 1 in 12 hours or a figure in a dosing table.
